node.statement: Fix the universal witnesses supplied by lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, lem-extcb-four-corner-merge, and lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control. Put M:=C_merge*(C_cross^0+1), choose e_3:=min{1,a_merge/(2*(C_cross^0+1)),e_iso_unit/(2*(abs(M)+1))}, and put D_3:=1+abs(M)+abs(C_iso_unit)*(abs(M)+1). Then e_3>0 and D_3<infinity are universal, (C_cross^0+1)*e_3<=a_merge, (M+1)*e_3<=e_iso_unit, M<=D_3, and C_iso_unit*(M+1)<=D_3.
